description: This file defines the SplitInfo class used in Apache Spark to represent information about data splits, including methods for converting Hadoop input splits into Spark SplitInfo instances.

classes.name: SplitInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a specific data split, including its format class, location, path, size, and underlying split object.

methods.name: toSplitInfo
methods.description: Converts Hadoop InputSplit objects into a sequence of Spark SplitInfo instances, for both mapred and mapreduce APIs.
